resources.string: Languages: %1$slang shows your enabled keyboard languages; a tap switches the keyboard to it at once and removes the command. You can also type %1$s and a language, a country or a short form, even with typos: %1$ssp, %1$sspain, %1$sspanisch, %1$sger, %1$sdeutsch, %1$seng, %1$senglish, %1$susa. Command names always win (%1$surl stays the URL command). Enabled: %2$s
Only one keyboard language is enabled. Opens the language settings to add one.
